say: You. The fight we lost. A Shek remembers a defeat longer than a victory. I won't begin it again.
I know that face. You bested a Shek spear and did it cleanly enough. Pass, and do not make me regret it.
The Stone Golem teaches that the beaten must learn. I have learned.
We lost to you once. A Shek doesn't hide from that, and doesn't ask for a second.
A good fighter. I keep my hand from my blade, and I'd like you to notice it.
You. I haven't forgotten who left us bleeding. Move along before I forget my orders.
Shek blood dried in the dust and you walk free.
A Shek can be beaten. A Shek can't be made to like it.
Don't smile. We remember, and one day the numbers will favour us.
That fight cost us men and pride. I mean to take the pride back.
Up and walking. I remember your squad on the ground.
Those who fall to us don't often come back this way.
Still alive? The Shek were merciful. Don't mistake it for weakness.
You again. We stood and you didn't.
You are the one who beat our spears. I will say nothing of it, and you will say nothing of it.
Pass, outlander. A Shek knows a stronger arm when he has felt it.
I was told about you. The Stone Golem would call it a lesson. I call it a sore ribcage.
We have no quarrel today. We had one once, and I remember how it ended.
Walk quickly. Our brothers aren't the only thing that fell that day. Our pride went down with them.
You are not welcome in my sight. You are tolerated. Remember the difference.
I smile for the law of the Kingdom. Not for you. Pass.
There is a debt there, outlander.
I remember what we did to your squad. Remember it too, and keep to the road.
The Kingdom was gentle with you once. It has a long memory and a short patience.
You walked away from us once. Don't take that for a habit.
We broke you and let you go. A Shek doesn't boast of it.
You're the one. Half the boys went down and you didn't. Keep walkin', I ain't paid for this.
I ain't startin' nothin'. Last time we started it, we lost teeth.
Easy now. I seen what you do.
I know you. Put half of us in the dirt.
Take what you like off the road, just leave me out of it.
You! You put my mates down. I'll be sharpenin' somethin' for you.
Still got the limp from you. Hope you enjoy walkin' around.
We had a good thing goin' till you showed up, /INSULT/.
Hope it was worth it, you /BASTARD/. Some of 'em had family.
Count your steps. One of 'em's gonna be wrong.
Well look at that. Still breathin'. Last time you weren't doin' much of anythin'.
Back again? Last time we left you eatin' dust. Do it again, will you?
You wake up with all your teeth? We was feelin' kind.
Remember who walked away that day, /INSULT/? It weren't you.
You beat us. The brotherhood respects a hard blow, and I'll not pick that fight today.
A fine fighter. We lived as brothers and you split us. Go in peace.
You stood against the Reavers and got up after. That's a hero's story. Don't make it a short one.
Heroes lose too. I hold no grudge today.
Move on. I was told to remember your face, not draw on it.
Brothers fell to you. The brotherhood never forgets, it's the only thing it does well.
You walk like the road is yours. It was ours before you came and spilled us over it.
I want your name. The brothers will ask who did it.
You broke what we were. I'll break something of yours, someday.
Every brother you put down has a name. I know them all. I'll say them to you one by one.
We broke your squad and let you crawl off. The Reavers are generous.
Remember the day we put you down? We do. It was a good day.
You live because we allowed it. Remember who has the right.
Eh, it's you. Not lookin' for trouble this time.
I ain't draggin' my sabre for you.
You're the one who took the lads. Go on, I'll look the other way.
Don't start, eh? We've all had our share of bleedin' from you.
Walk on. Today we don't want your blood.
You! You dropped the lads in the muck like they was nothin'.
My brother's still not right after what you did, you /BASTARD/.
You took a bite out of us in blood, and we ain't forgot the taste.
Can't forget that, eh? Ain't gonna.
Hope the ground was kind to you, /INSULT/.
Hah! Look who crawled back. Last time you went off bleedin'.
Remember how we left you? Eh? Face down in the dirt.
We put you down once. Can do it twice, /INSULT/.
You walk like you won somethin'. You didn't.
You... you hit hard. We ain't got the strength to try again. Please.
Don't hurt us. Don't. We learned. We learned already.
I know you. You left us on the ground. I won't get up for you again.
Leave us. Leave us be. We got nothin' you want, honest.
I'm too hungry to be brave. You take your fight somewhere else.
You left us weaker. We didn't have much to lose before, but you found some.
You with your food. You with your boots. You beat us and went on eatin'.
I remember you. I remember how it felt. It's the only thing I got left to remember.
Somebody's gonna get fed for what you did.
Fight a starving man, fine. Starve and see how the fight feels.
We beat you once. Still hungry.
You lost to starvin' men. Think about that on your way.
Remember us, the ones who put you down? Rememberin' don't fill a belly, but it's somethin'.
Last time we had you. Didn't even get a good meal out of it.
Hmph. You again. A Shek honours the stronger blade. I don't draw today.
You beat the Band. I keep my place and you keep yours.
I felt your steel once. It was enough.
We were bested, and not by luck.
Pass. I would rather live to be better than die to be proud.
Beaten by an outsider. I have turned it over a hundred times.
Bones remember. Every cut you gave. Pass before I count them.
You made the Band look weak. Weak men don't forget that.
The Band was a name that frightened people. You've made it a lesson. I don't thank you.
I will have my reckoning. Not today. But I will.
We beat you once and left you the breath to learn from it.
The Band took you apart. It wasn't even hard.
Don't stand so proud. The ground remembers where you lay.
You walk like a man who forgot.
Aye, you. Not lookin' for round two. We got all the lumps we need.
I ain't forgot. Put the sword away, and I'll put mine away.
Easy. I'll steer clear of you if you steer clear of me.
You're good. I'll admit that much. Don't ask me for more.
Walk on. The crew's had enough of you for a lifetime.
You took the crew apart, you /BASTARD/. I'll not forget a single one.
I got a score to settle and your face is on it.
Cost us men, cost us a good haul. I'll want it back, one way or the other.
You're the one. Heh. I've not slept well since.
Watch your back, /INSULT/. Pirates never forget a thing.
Ha! Yer the one we beat down. Back for more, are ye?
We left you in the dirt. How's the view from standin' up?
Don't look so sour. It's only losin'. We lost plenty ourselves, once.
Remember us, do ya? Good. Keep rememberin'.
You. That fight cost us hands and a day's work.
I know you. Business is business, and you were poor business.
Keep walkin'. A beaten hunter is a poor hunter, and I'm a poor one today.
We lost the last tangle. Stock don't come cheap, but you come costlier.
I'll not shackle you today. Don't mistake that for mercy.
That fight cost us men, and men cost money. Someone owes, and you know who.
I keep a ledger of debts. You're on the first page.
You'd fetch a fine price, you know. Maybe not today, but someday.
I lost good people to your lot.
Someone's chains are still waiting for a neck.
We broke your squad. Fine stock, some of 'em.
You'd have fetched a fair price once.
You lost, and we let you leave. Think of it as an advance.
Remember the last time? So do I.
Hm. You're the one who cost us at the last scrap. Can't say I'll miss that.
Business is business. Your fight with us was bad for it. Let's keep it quiet from here.
I know you. I'll leave you be.
You've cost us once already. I'd rather sell than fight.
You aren't forgiven. Just noted.
That fight cost us stock, and stock costs cats. I'd rather not talk about it.
I see you. I'm not pleased to.
I haven't forgotten the cost. You'll pay one way or another.
You're the one who beat us. Outlawed, not stupid. Walk on.
The Nation cast us out and you broke us after. I'll not give you the satisfaction of a second fight.
We learned. The hard way, as the Nation teaches everything.
I know you. I'll keep my blade down, and my prayers up.
Go. Even outcasts know when the Flame isn't on their side.
The Nation threw us out and you finished the job of ruining us.
You took no god from me. Only friends.
I'll not forget, outlander. The fires we've left are burning for you.
Every cut you gave me is a lesson, and I don't thank the teacher.
We were outcasts and now we're less.
The Nation threw us out and still we beat you.
Even outcasts have steel. You learned it the hard way.
Remember us, do you? The Flame remembers you.
You fell to outcasts. Pray the Nation never hears of it.
/UG/. You. You hurt us. No fight now.
You strong. Cannibals remember strong. Not fight.
Hurt. Still hurt. /UG/. Go, go.
You, dhe one. Meat run away from you. Not us, not now.
No eat you. No fight you. Bad meat, hit back too hard.
You /CANNIBALCURSE/. You kill ours. We remember. We eat you.
Brodher gone. You do. /UG/. Cannibals not forget.
Mine blood. Your blood. Same, soon.
You walk, walk. We watch. We wait.
Face I know. Teeth I know.
You back. Meat back. /UG/. We knock you down once, we do again.
We got you once. You walk away. Lucky meat.
Remember. You fall. We stand. Cannibals strong.
/UG/. You hurt, we hurt more. Still alibe, you, for now.
Hounds remember. You hit hard for a stranger. Hounds don't bark at things that bite back.
Not tonight. The pack licked its wounds and learned your smell.
You're the one. The pack said leave you be.
I got no quarrel today. Last time ended with my head ringing.
Easy. Hounds know when to circle and when to lie down.
You bled the pack. The swamp is wide, but the Hounds' memory is wider.
Remember the howls? That was us, hurtin'.
No man tells the Hounds what to do, and no stranger breaks them and walks free.
I'll find you in the swamp, outsider.
Hounds mourn their own. You made us mourn. We'll mourn you.
Hounds put you down once. It's why you walk soft now.
Heh. The pack laid you out.
You came at the Hounds and the Hounds put you down.
Arooo. You lost, stranger. The swamp remembers.
You cost us some good hands. Everything has a price, and yours was too high. Move along.
I do business with people who win. You won. Walk on.
I'll not make trouble. I'll only make a note.
The Blackshifters can read a loss. We lost.
You were an expense we would rather not repeat.
You owe the Blackshifters for what you did. We keep accounts, and we collect.
Every man you put down was owed money by someone.
You'll pay, outsider. In cats or in blood.
I'd say something sharp, but I'll keep it for the day it matters.
We never forget a debt. Enjoy your freedom while the interest builds.
We put your squad down for free. Next time we'll send a bill.
You lost to the Blackshifters. Think of the cost.
The last time we met, you left some of yourself on the floor. Fair price.
You paid in blood. We take cats, too, if you have them.
Two blades, one fight, and you won it. Credit where it's due.
I know the face. My blades know your guard. Neither of us needs round two.
Not today. I've still got the stitches from last time.
You beat us. The Twinblades don't forget that, nor do they beg for another.
Walk on. My blades are sheathed.
My blades remember what yours did.
You're the one who took the Twinblades down a peg. I'll bring it back up.
Sleep light, outsider. Blades are quiet.
You made fools of us. A fool with two blades is worse than a clever man with one.
I owe you a pair of cuts. Two blades, two cuts.
Two blades beat your lot once.
You lost to the Twinblades. The cuts heal.
Heh. I recall how you looked on the ground.
We cut you down once. Twice is no harder.
